keyPoints: Prachin kaal me log suraj, chandrama aur taaron ki sthiti se samay jaante the — ghadi na hone par aakash hi samay batata tha.
Dhoop-ghadi (sundial) me suraj ki roshni se banti chhaya ki lambai aur disha se samay naapa jaata tha; dopahar me chhaya sabse chhoti hoti hai.
Chandrama ki kalaon se mahine gine jaate the — amavasya se purnima tak lagbhag 15 din ka pakhwada hota hai.
Nakshatra (taaron ke samooh) disha aur ritu batane me madad karte the; Saptarshi aasaani se pehchana jaata hai aur dhruv taara uttar dikhata hai.
Prithvi ke dhuri ke jhukav se suraj ki sthiti badalti hai — garmi me suraj uncha aur sardi me neecha dikhta hai, isi se mausam bante hain.
Aaj parmanu ghadiyan sabse sateek samay deti hain, par kisaano ke liye aakash aaj bhi prakriti ki ghadi hai — fasal ke liye ritu ka gyaan zaroori hai.
Aam galti: taare sthir hain ye manna; dharti ke ghoomne se taare poorab se pashchim khisakte dikhte hain, isiliye raat bhar unki sthiti badalti hai.

title: Aakash se Samay ki Pehchan
